 AP Schools Holiday Tomorrow: Schools Closed Due To Elections
 -->
 -->
 Sakshi Education 4 November 2026 -->
 Schools in Andhra Pradesh will remain closed tomorrow, November 5, 2026, in view of the MPTC and ZPTC elections. 
 AP School Holiday: Schools Closed on November 5 Due to Elections 
 The holiday has been announced to facilitate polling arrangements and election-related activities at schools being used as polling stations.
 The MPTC and ZPTC elections are scheduled to take place on November 5. Several school buildings will be used as polling centres, requiring arrangements for the smooth conduct of the elections.
 Schools Closed on November 5? 
 The holiday is related to the ongoing rural local body election process in Andhra Pradesh. Schools selected as polling stations will be used for election arrangements and polling activities.
 The government has announced holidays on November 4 and 5 in connection with the Parishad elections.
 Which Schools Will Remain Closed? 
 The November 5 holiday mainly applies to:
 Schools designated as polling stations.
 Educational institutions covered by the election arrangements.
 Schools where election-related activities are scheduled.
 However, the holiday may not apply uniformly to all schools. Students and parents are advised to confirm the holiday with their respective school management.
